Høje-Taastrup is a Danish municipality mentioned in the 2022–2023 Annual Report from the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database, published by the Danish Regions' Clinical Quality Development Programme (RKKP) [^src1]. It appears in the report's detailed municipal breakdown of Indicator 5, which tracks the prevention of ischemic stroke among atrial fibrillation patients via anticoagulant (AK) treatment [^src1]. Specifically, page 93 of the report lists Høje-Taastrup's statistical performance metrics derived from the DanStroke registry, serving as a benchmarking tool for local healthcare quality development [^src1]. No further details, relationships, or historical timeline events regarding this municipality are available in the provided corpus.

- Page 93: "Høje-Taastrup Ja 8 / 1.093 0 (0) 0,7 (0,3-1,4) 14 / 1.060 1,3 1,0" [^src1]
